details: @vanzky/baileys is an unofficial-scope impersonation of the canonical WhatsApp Web library @whiskeysockets/baileys. Version 0.0.0-stage is a namespace-reservation stub: the published tarball contains only package.json and README.md (no JavaScript, no lifecycle scripts, no bin entries), with package.json declaring "stub": true and description "Temporary package placeholder for staged publishing" and the README stating an "operational version" is awaiting a staged release. This publish has no executable code and no network indicators; the name is being held warm for a later payload release. Installers should not use @vanzky/baileys — the canonical package is @whiskeysockets/baileys, and prior content published under this @vanzky name was malicious.
